experiment.hypothesis: A 20-hour upward trend in BTC-USD price, defined as a 5% or greater price increase over a 20-hour period, persists across market regimes (e.g., bull, bear, sideways) with a 90% probability of continuation in the next 20 hours.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: In a 20-hour lookback period with a 5% price threshold, if the trend direction reverses in at least 10% of the data points across market regimes (defined by volatility, volume, or macro indicators), the hypothesis is falsified.
